tools.name: coverage
tools.description: What SeoulMarkets has actually collected: datasets, row counts, date ranges, and what is NOT covered. Call this first when unsure whether a question can be answered.

tools.name: korea_trade_by_country
tools.description: Korea exports, imports and trade balance by partner country and month (customs basis). National totals by default.

tools.name: trade_countries
tools.description: Partner country codes with English names, for use with korea_trade_by_country.

tools.name: hs_code_lookup
tools.description: Resolve an HS code (2, 4, 6 or 10 digits) to its English description.

tools.name: hs_code_search
tools.description: Search HS chapters and headings by English keyword.

tools.name: company_valuation
tools.description: PER, PBR, ROE and debt-to-equity for listed Korean companies, with the price date and the financial-statement vintage each multiple was computed from.

tools.name: company_financials
tools.description: Annual financial statements of Korean listed companies as filed to DART, with English account names.

tools.name: analyst_target_prices
tools.description: Analyst target-price reports and analyst rankings for Korean listed companies. Facts only, no report text.

tools.name: brokerage_research
tools.description: Brokerage target prices and ratings, 2007 onward. Filter by broker, subject company, date, rating or stance.

tools.name: research_institutions
tools.description: Korean research institutions in English: official names, rename history, and which ones actually issue target prices.

tools.name: krx_index_series
tools.description: Dated time series for KRX indices, in English. Use list=true to see the index names available.

tools.name: ownership_filings
tools.description: Substantial-shareholding (5% rule) and officer/major-shareholder ownership filings for Korean listed companies.

tools.name: convertible_bond_filings
tools.description: Convertible bond, bond-with-warrant and exchangeable bond issuance filings in Korea.

tools.name: workforce_filings
tools.description: Workforce filings for listed Korean companies: headcount, tenure and pay, by gender.

tools.name: account_dictionary
tools.description: Korean financial-statement account names mapped to standard English.

tools.name: uae_company_financials
tools.description: Revenue, net profit, EPS and (where reconciled) balance sheet for Abu Dhabi (ADX) and Dubai (DFM) listed companies.

tools.name: japan_company_financials
tools.description: Latest annual accounts of Tokyo-listed companies as filed with EDINET: revenue, operating and net profit, equity, EPS and the filed PER. One row per company.

tools.name: taiwan_company_financials
tools.description: Latest quarterly accounts of TWSE-listed companies: revenue and profit (year-to-date), balance sheet, closing price, PER, PBR and dividend yield. One row per company.
